brief: 5 content tools that quietly replaced a $5K/month creator agency.

slots.desc1: All-in-one workspace for content calendars, briefs, and team collaboration.
slots.desc2: Generates full blog drafts, hooks, and captions in your brand voice.
slots.desc3: Drag-and-drop design suite for social posts, decks, and brand assets.
slots.desc4: Schedules and publishes across every major channel from one dashboard.
slots.desc5: Edits video by editing text, auto-removes filler words and captions.

slots.toolTagline: Your entire content strategy living in one connected workspace.
slots.bigStatement: Notion replaced our $5K agency’s project manager, calendar, and brief templates overnight.
slots.use1Body: Map out a month of posts, statuses, and owners in one view.
slots.use2Body: Standardize every video, blog, and graphic request with reusable templates.
slots.use3Body: Store scripts, links, and brand files where the whole team finds them.

slots.toolTagline: An on-demand copywriter that drafts, edits, and brainstorms in seconds.
slots.bigStatement: OpenAI turned blank-page syndrome into publish-ready copy without a single agency revision cycle.
slots.use1Body: Generate ten scroll-stopping intros for any product or story angle.
slots.use2Body: Turn bullet points into full YouTube scripts or newsletter sections.
slots.use3Body: Rewrite dry paragraphs to match your brand voice and audience.

slots.toolTagline: A design studio in your browser with templates for every channel.
slots.bigStatement: Canva eliminated design bottlenecks so we stopped waiting three days for agency mockups.
slots.use1Body: Resize one design into every platform format with a single click.
slots.use2Body: Lock colors, fonts, and logos so every asset stays perfectly on brand.
slots.use3Body: Animate text and stitch scenes without touching professional editing software.

slots.toolTagline: The simplest way to queue, time, and publish across every network.
slots.bigStatement: Buffer replaced our social media manager by auto-publishing the exact calendar the agency charged $2K to run.
slots.use1Body: Drop content into a calendar and let it roll out on schedule.
slots.use2Body: Auto-schedule when your audience is actually online and engaging.
slots.use3Body: Publish to LinkedIn, Instagram, X, and TikTok from one composer.

slots.toolTagline: Edit video and audio by editing text, not timelines.
slots.bigStatement: Descript cut our podcast and Reels turnaround from a week to a single afternoon.
slots.use1Body: Delete filler words and mistakes just by highlighting transcript text.
slots.use2Body: Generate accurate subtitles styled to your brand in one click.
slots.use3Body: Fix bad audio takes by typing new words in your cloned voice.

slots.toolTagline: The silent automation layer that moves work between every app.
slots.bigStatement: Zapier is the invisible project manager that shuttles briefs, files, and alerts between tools 24/7.
slots.use1Body: Trigger a Notion brief whenever a new row hits your content sheet.
slots.use2Body: Send finished Canva designs straight into Buffer and your drive.
slots.use3Body: Ping Slack or email when a video exports or post goes live.

slots.body: Replace expensive retainers with lean tools that ship content faster, cheaper, and exactly how you want it.
